:::{#def-tuning-parameter}
#### Tuning parameter

A **tuning parameter** of a [fitting procedure](#def-fitting-procedure)
is a setting $\lambda$ that the procedure needs
but does not compute from the [training set](#def-training-set),
such as the degree of a polynomial fit:

$$
\fitted(x) = g_{\lambda}\paren{x; \trainset}.
$$ {#eq-tuning-parameter}

:::
